# Pull request

## Summary

Describe the change and why it is needed.

## Changed files

List the files or directories changed.

## Verification

Commands run and observed results. CI must be checked on the first pull
request that uses this workflow.

## Checklist

- [ ] Change is scoped to the approved work package.
- [ ] No secrets, credentials, tokens, or private data are included.
- [ ] Documentation and contracts are updated when behavior changes.
- [ ] Manifest or checksum changes are intentional and reviewed.
- [ ] CI results are reported or explained.
